title.zh: 9 月 3–4 日重置卡发放说明

summary.en: OpenAI documents banked-reset grants for eligible Plus, Pro and Business accounts during the Astra rollout. Eligibility and delivery can differ by account.
summary.zh: OpenAI 已说明 Astra 推送期间面向符合条件的 Plus、Pro 和 Business 账号发放重置卡；资格与到账时间可能因账号而异。

interpretation.en: This confirms a grant programme, not an automatic refill of your quota. It does not establish an exact delivery time for either batch or for this account.
interpretation.zh: 这是重置卡发放方案的确认，不是你的额度已经自动恢复；它也不能证明任一批次或当前账号的确切到账时间。

title.en: A saved reset is different from an automatic reset
title.zh: 保存的重置卡与自动重置不是同一回事

summary.en: A banked reset remains available until used or expired. Using a full reset can refresh eligible short and weekly windows and change the weekly reset date.
summary.zh: 重置卡可保留至使用或到期；使用完整重置卡可刷新适用的短周期和周窗口，并改变周重置日期。

interpretation.en: A later reset date alone is not proof of a forced global reset. Normal rollover and manual credit use must also be considered.
interpretation.zh: 重置日期延后本身不证明官方强制重置；还应排除正常周期到期和主动使用重置卡。

title.zh: 8 月 31 日广泛重置公告线索

summary.en: Two public trackers point to the same statement about a broad reset for paid subscriptions. The primary post could not be read during this review.
summary.zh: 两个公开追踪站点指向同一条付费订阅广泛重置公告；本次核对未能读取原帖。

interpretation.en: Retained for review, not displayed as independently verified confirmation. Two mirrors of one post are one evidence family.
interpretation.zh: 保留线索供核实，不显示为已独立核实的官方确认；同一条原帖的两次转载仍只算一个证据族。

title.zh: 9 月 7 日用量页面变化线索

summary.en: A tracker marked a reset as confirmed using a usage-dashboard observation. Its record does not provide a public broad-reset announcement.
summary.zh: 追踪站点依据用量页面观测将一次变化标为已重置，但记录没有提供面向广泛用户的公开重置公告。

interpretation.en: An account-level observation cannot establish a global forced reset or whether this device's account received one.
interpretation.zh: 账号层面的观测不能确认全局强制重置，也不能证明本机账号已获得重置。
